name: W-003 CRM and Booking Handoff (Stromation template)

parameters.content:
## W-003 CRM and Booking Handoff

**Purpose:** turn a validated structured-lead object into a clean CRM record plus a booking link or a human task.

**Controls:** schema validation before routing, deterministic safety override beats confidence, search-before-create, ambiguous matches go to a human, CRM failures fail safe to a human task, AI summary never overwrites authoritative fields.

**Input:** POST the structured AI output schema (see fixtures/w-003-lead.json).
